code_findings: Forward release requests CMD0 while retaining ARM intent; directions enabled after release ACK is expected.
DISARM admission in PAGE clears intent/controlId/motion/timer and supersedes the pending request before ws.send; direction DOM flags update before the synchronous handler returns, not after STM ACK.
Delayed CMD/ARM ACK, DISARM rejection/timeout and retained ACTIVE snapshots do not set intent=true again in the tested paths.
Disconnect/reconnect clears local control; old socket messages are ignored and the replacement socket sends only HELLO until manual input.
Server manual DISARM bypasses normal PING/CMD rate and busy gates; its dedicated stop-result slot may return BUSY, which does not reenable local intent.
Closing the owning session invokes executor stop, so DISARMED alone cannot identify a manual button cause.

decision.historical_cause: UNDETERMINED: run02 has no click/send/disconnect trace for the interval in question
decision.current_manual_disarm_evidence: Three later independent logs preserve manual click, disabled directions and OK result before focus loss.
decision.next: Continue final MVP evidence/scope reconciliation. Keep the historical observation OPEN; do not claim a root-cause fix. If the symptom recurs, preserve the v5.1 trace and screen state instead of repeating distance trials.
decision.limitations: Mock tests do not test browser hit-testing/rendering, OS input, every event interleaving, or flashed-image identity. Missing historical events cannot be recovered from these tests.
